title: Universal cell embedding provides a foundation model for cell biology
methods: expression-weighted gene sampling with replacement (1,024 tokens)
zero-shot embedding of unseen datasets and species

data_scope.training_atlas: Integrated Mega-scale Atlas (IMA): over 36 million cells, more than 1,000 uniquely named cell types, more than 300 datasets, dozens of tissues
data_scope.cellxgene_share: 33.9 million cells across 285 datasets (human + mouse, primary cells only)
data_scope.non_census_share: 2.3 million cells across 28 datasets covering the remaining species
data_scope.subsample_rule: 10,000 cells randomly drawn per dataset (or full dataset if smaller); mean 9,486 cells per dataset; labels coarsened to 51 coarse cell types
data_scope.primary_benchmark: Tabula Sapiens v.2 — 581,430 cells, 27 tissues, 167 batches, 162 unique cell types
data_scope.gene_expression_baseline: 5,704 genes shared across all 184 human IMA datasets
data_scope.preprocessing: cells filtered at >=200 genes, genes at >=10 cells; no highly-variable-gene selection; no batch correction
data_scope.model_size: 33 layers, >650 million parameters, 1,280-d cell embedding, 1,024 sampled gene tokens, ESM2 protein embeddings of dimension 5,120
data_scope.compute: 40 days on 24 x NVIDIA A100 80 GB GPUs
data_scope.unknowns: Exact dataset count and per-species cell counts are given only as bounds in the main text ('more than 300 datasets', 'over 36 million cells', 'dozens of tissues'); the full roster is in Supplementary Table 16 and exact hyperparameters in Supplementary Table 2, neither of which is in the scraped main text.

core_conclusion: UCE is a self-supervised transformer foundation model that maps any single cell from any tissue or species into one shared 1,280-dimensional latent space with no labels, no retraining and no fine-tuning. Universality comes from the tokenizer: genes are represented by ESM2 protein-language embeddings of their protein products, making the model genome-agnostic and independent of orthology mapping. Applied to build the 36-million-cell Integrated Mega-scale Atlas, the space shows emergent structure it was never trained for — germ-layer lineages, Cell-Ontology-consistent distances, and correct cell-type transfer to unseen species — and a simple logistic classifier over the embeddings rediscovered kidney Norn cells and identified Norn-like cells in lung and heart, including in IPF and COPD lungs.
why_it_matters: Removes the per-dataset retraining tax that made single-cell embeddings non-comparable across studies; demonstrates that universality is purchased at the tokenizer (protein-sequence descriptors) rather than by more data; delivers quantitative gains of +13.9% overall, +16.2% bio-conservation and +10.1% batch correction over the next-best zero-shot model, and 65% more accurate cross-atlas cell-type alignment than raw expression space; and converts a static atlas into a searchable hypothesis engine, yielding a concrete biological finding (Norn-like, EPO-associated cells outside the kidney).
why_nature: A universality claim with a falsifiable test (species never seen in training), emergent capability anchored to canonical biology rather than to benchmark scores, an actual biological discovery closing the loop from method to disease, open weights/code/embeddings that make it infrastructure for the Human Cell Atlas and virtual-cell agenda, and a Discussion that is explicit about black-box opacity, mammal/brain-biased training data and degradation at large evolutionary distance.
added_value_to_my_research: Context tokens on a 'bag of entities' encoder -> neighbourhood-conditioned transferable place embeddings from POI bags
Calibrated nearest-neighbour retrieval + conformal sets -> per-tract uncertainty and out-of-support flags for 2SFCA/R2SFCA transfer
Distance-stratified transfer-decay curve -> quantitative competence boundary for geospatial foundation models, paired with MGWR non-stationarity
Sparse dictionary over frozen embeddings -> concept-level explanations for geospatial representations instead of post-hoc SHAP on features
Descriptor-space tokenization instead of categorical codes -> POI/land-use models portable across incompatible national taxonomies
